goal: Implement Albert Hazan's 2026-09-10 owner policy that governed reviewers may run concurrent independent jobs. Replace the single active lease per reviewer with assignment-keyed leases while preserving exact-head binding, independent slots, durable verdicts, atomic release/replacement, and compatibility for active legacy leases.
prohibited_actions: Do not weaken exact-head, independence, durable-verdict, atomic-transition, or legacy-lease safeguards
Do not alter reviewer eligibility, roster, or provider wrappers
Do not merge until the governed pull-request route has two durable exact-head approvals
assumptions: The owner clarification supersedes the historical one-active-lease capacity assumption but not the evidence and independence safeguards.
Legacy refs remain readable and releasable so no active review is invalidated by this change.
Concurrent leases are keyed by the durable assignment tuple and only exact 40-character production heads enter the new namespace.
stop_conditions: A required test shows a concurrent lease can overwrite, release, or authorize a sibling assignment
The change would require relaxing an existing exact-head or independent-review rule
The work expands into database structure or application behavior
